paragraphs.sourceText: The desert is deceiving. At first glance it looks lifeless, barren, and bone-dry. For most passersby humming through the Mojave on their way to try their luck in Las Vegas or heading towards the Grand Canyon, it’s just a 26 stretch of land with some mountains in the distance and more 27 to be a setting for a movie that takes place on Mars. The desert, however, is 28 with life, mystery, and magic.
paragraphs.translationZh: 沙漠是骗人的。乍一看，它看起来毫无生气、贫瘠、干燥。对于大多数在拉斯维加斯碰碰运气或前往大峡谷途中穿过莫哈韦沙漠的路人来说，这只是一片平坦的土地，远处有一些山脉，更适合作为发生在火星上的电影的背景。然而，沙漠却充满了生机、神秘和魔法。

paragraphs.sourceText: The Mojave desert sees less than two inches of rain a year, and like most deserts, is a land of 29 . Temperature fluctuations vary from freezing to 30 hot, not only between seasons, but even within the same day.
paragraphs.translationZh: 莫哈韦沙漠每年的降雨量不到两英寸，与大多数沙漠一样，是一片极端的土地。不仅季节之间，甚至同一天内，温度波动也从冰冻到炎热不等。

paragraphs.sourceText: At the heart of this vast, 25,000-square-mile desert is Mojave National Preserve. The folks managing and working there wear the wide-brimmed (宽边的) hats that have become 31 with places like Yosemite. The preserve is rich with history, culture, biodiversity, and endless opportunities to 32 your interest, especially for anyone who loves the outdoors. For a photographer, it requires patience and 33 a few spare tires to maneuver the network of unpaved “roads”, but the rewards are plenty.
paragraphs.translationZh: 莫哈韦国家保护区位于这片占地 25,000 平方英里的广阔沙漠的中心。在那里管理和工作的人们都戴着宽边的帽子，这已经成为优胜美地等地方的代名词。该保护区拥有丰富的历史、文化、生物多样性，以及激发您兴趣的无尽机会，尤其是对于热爱户外活动的人来说。对于摄影师来说，需要耐心，可能还需要一些备胎来操纵未铺砌的“道路”网络，但回报也很丰富。

paragraphs.sourceText: Photographing here requires a good, 34 pair of shoes and a lot of preparation. Plenty of water, spare tires, and a full tank of gas are needed to explore this unit of the national park system, which is the third largest in the country.
paragraphs.translationZh: 在这里拍照需要一双优质、坚固的鞋子和大量的准备工作。探索国家公园系统的这个单元需要大量的水、备用轮胎和一整箱汽油，该系统是美国第三大国家公园系统。

paragraphs.sourceText: Like all deserts. though, if you are patient, you will be rewarded, as they often reveal their secrets slowly. During my last outing, I was surprised to see how much of the area was shaped by ancient volcanoes and geological forces, much of which remains today, giving the area a 35 feel and painting a colorful background for great photographs.
paragraphs.translationZh: 就像所有的沙漠一样。不过，如果你有耐心，你就会得到回报，因为他们经常慢慢地透露他们的秘密。在我上次郊游期间，我惊讶地发现该地区的大部分区域是由古代火山和地质力量塑造的，其中大部分至今仍然存在，赋予该地区独特的感觉，并为精彩照片绘制了色彩缤纷的背景。

paragraphs.sourceText: Directions: In this section, you are going to read a passage with ten statements attached to it. Each statement contains information given in one of the paragraphs. Identify the paragraph from which the information is derived. You may choose a paragraph more than once. Each paragraph is marked with a letter. Answer the questions by marking the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2.
paragraphs.translationZh: 说明：在本节中，您将阅读一段附有十个陈述的段落。每条陈述都包含其中一个段落中给出的信息。确定信息来源的段落。您可以多次选择一个段落。每个段落都标有一个字母。通过在答题卡 2 上标记相应的字母来回答问题。

paragraphs.sourceText: A) Most visitors come to Cape Canaveral, on the northeast coast of Florida, for the tourist attractions. It’s home to the second-busiest cruise ship port in the world and is a gateway to the cosmos. Nearly 1.5 million visitors flock here every year to watch rockets, spacecraft, and satellites blast off into the solar system from Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex. Nearly 64 kilometers of undeveloped beach and 648 square kilometers of protected refuge fan out from the cape’s sandy shores.
paragraphs.translationZh: A) 大多数游客来到佛罗里达州东北海岸的卡纳维拉尔角是为了旅游景点。它是世界上第二繁忙的游轮港口的所在地，也是通往宇宙的门户。每年有近 150 万游客涌入这里，观看火箭、航天器和卫星从肯尼迪航天中心游客中心发射升空进入太阳系。近 64 公里的未开发海滩和 648 平方公里的受保护避难所从海角的沙滩呈扇形展开。

paragraphs.sourceText: B) Yet some of Cape Canaveral’s most legendary attractions lie unseen, wedged under the sea’s surface in mud and sand, for this part of the world has a reputation as a deadly ship trap. Over the centuries, dozens of majestic Old World sailing ships smashed and sank on this irregular stretch of windy Florida coast. They were vessels built for war and commerce, crossing the globe carrying everything from coins to cannons, boxes of silver and gold, chests of jewels and porcelain, and pearls from the Caribbean.
paragraphs.translationZh: B) 然而，卡纳维拉尔角的一些最具传奇色彩的景点却是看不见的，它们被楔入海面的泥土和沙子中，因为世界的这一地区以致命的船只陷阱而闻名。几个世纪以来，数十艘雄伟的旧大陆帆船在佛罗里达州这片不规则的多风海岸上撞毁沉没。它们是为战争和商业而建造的船只，载着从硬币到大炮、成箱的金银、成箱的珠宝和瓷器以及来自加勒比海的珍珠等各种物品穿越全球。

paragraphs.sourceText: C) Cape Canaveral contains one of the greatest concentrations of colonial shipwrecks in the world. In recent years, advances in radar, diving, detection equipment, computers, and GPS have transformed the hunt. The naked eye might see a pile of rocks, but technology can reveal the precious artifacts (人工制品) that lie hidden on the ocean floor.
paragraphs.translationZh: C) 卡纳维拉尔角是世界上殖民沉船最集中的地区之一。近年来，雷达、潜水、探测设备、计算机和全球定位系统的进步改变了狩猎方式。肉眼可能会看到一堆岩石，但技术可以揭示隐藏在海底的珍贵文物（手工制品）。

paragraphs.sourceText: D) As technology renders the seabed more accessible, the hunt for treasure-filled ships has drawn a fresh tide of salvors (打捞人员) and their investors — as well as marine archaeologists (考古学家) wanting to bring to light the lost relics. But of late, when salvors have found vessels, their rights have been challenged in court. The big question: who should have control of these treasures?
paragraphs.translationZh: D) 随着技术的进步，海底的探寻变得更加容易，对装满宝藏的船只的搜寻吸引了新一轮打捞人员及其投资者，以及希望重见天日的海洋考古学家。但最近，当救助者发现船只时，他们的权利在法庭上受到质疑。最大的问题是：谁应该控制这些宝藏？

paragraphs.sourceText: E) High-stakes fights over shipwrecks pit archaeologists against treasure hunters in a vicious cycle of accusations. Archaeologists regard themselves as protectors of history, and they see salvors as careless destroyers. Salvors feel they do the hard work of searching for ships, only to have them stolen from under them when discovered. This kind of clash inevitably takes place on a grand scale. Aside from the salvors, their investors, and the maritime archaeologists who serve as expert witnesses, the battles sweep in local and international governments and organizations like UNESCO that work to protect under-water heritage. The court cases that ensue stretch on for years. Are finders keepers, or do the ships belong to the countries that made them and sent them sailing centuries ago? Where once salvors and archaeologists worked side by side, now they belong to opposing, and equally contemptuous, tribes.
paragraphs.translationZh: E) 围绕沉船事件的高风险斗争让考古学家与寻宝者陷入相互指责的恶性循环。考古学家将自己视为历史的保护者，而他们将救助者视为粗心的破坏者。救助者认为，他们辛辛苦苦地寻找船只，但发现船只后却被偷走了。这种冲突不可避免地会大规模发生。除了救助者、投资者和作为专家证人的海洋考古学家之外，这场斗争还席卷了地方和国际政府以及联合国教科文组织等致力于保护水下遗产的组织。随后发生的法庭案件持续了数年。发现者是守护者，还是这些船只属于几个世纪前制造它们并让它们航行的国家？打捞者和考古学家曾经并肩工作，现在他们属于对立且同样轻蔑的部落。

paragraphs.sourceText: F) Nearly three million vessels lie wrecked on the Earth’s ocean floor — from old canoes to the Titanic — and likely less than one percent have been explored. Some — like an ancient Roman ship found off Antikythera, Greece, dated between 70 and 60 BC and carrying astonishingly sophisticated gears and dials for navigating by the sun — are critical to a new understanding of our past. No wonder there is an eternal stirring among everybody from salvors to scholars to find them.
paragraphs.translationZh: F) 地球海底有近 300 万艘船只失事——从旧独木舟到泰坦尼克号——而且可能只有不到百分之一已被勘探过。其中一些——比如在希腊安提基西拉附近发现的一艘古罗马船，其历史可以追溯到公元前 70 至 60 年之间，上面载有极其复杂的齿轮和刻度盘，用于靠太阳导航——对于我们重新了解过去至关重要。难怪从救助者到学者，每个人都热衷于寻找它们。

paragraphs.sourceText: G) In May 2016, a salvor named Bobby Pritchett, president of Global Marine Exploration (GME) in Tampa, Florida, announced that he had discovered scattered remains of a ship buried a kilometer off Cape Canaveral. Over the prior three years, he and his crew had obtained 14 state permits to survey a nearly 260-square-kilometer area off the cape; they worked 250 days a year, backed by investor funds of, he claims, US $4 million. It was hard work. Crew members were up at dawn, dragging sensors from their expedition vessels back and forth, day in and day out, year after year, to detect metal of any kind. Using computer technology, Pritchett and his crew created intricate, color-coded maps marked with the GPS coordinates of thousands of finds, all invisible under a meter of sand.
paragraphs.translationZh: G) 2016 年 5 月，佛罗里达州坦帕市全球海洋勘探公司 (GME) 总裁鲍比·普里切特 (Bobby Pritchett) 宣布，他发现了一艘埋在卡纳维拉尔角附近一公里处的散落船只残骸。在过去的三年里，他和他的团队获得了 14 份州许可证，可以对海角附近近 260 平方公里的区域进行勘察；他们每年工作 250 天，资金来源是他声称的 400 万美元。这很辛苦。船员们黎明时分就起床，日复一日、年复一年地从探险船上来回拖曳传感器，以检测任何类型的金属。普里切特和他的团队利用计算机技术创建了复杂的彩色地图，上面标有数千个发现物的 GPS 坐标，这些发现物在一米深的沙子下都是看不见的。

paragraphs.sourceText: H) One day in 2015, the magnetometer (磁力计) picked up metal that turned out to be an iron cannon; when the divers blew the sand away, they also discovered a more precious bronze cannon with markings indicating French royalty and, not far off, a famous marble column carved with the coat of arms of France, known from historical paintings. The discovery was cause for celebration. The artifacts indicated the divers had likely found the wreck of La Trinity, a 16th-century French vessel that had been at the center of a bloody battle between France and Spain that changed the fate of the United States of America.
paragraphs.translationZh: H) 2015年的一天，磁力计拾到金属，原来是铁炮；当潜水员把沙子吹走时，他们还发现了一门更珍贵的青铜大炮，上面有法国皇室的标记，在不远处，还有一根著名的大理石柱，上面刻有历史绘画中的法国国徽。这一发现值得庆祝。这些文物表明，潜水员很可能发现了 La Trinity 号的残骸，这是一艘 16 世纪的法国船只，曾处于法国和西班牙之间血腥战斗的中心，这场战斗改变了美利坚合众国的命运。

paragraphs.sourceText: I) And then the legal storm began, with GME and Pritchett pitted against Florida and France. The Sunken Military Craft Act of 2004, a US federal act, protects any vessel that was on a military mission, allowing the originating country to claim their ship even centuries later. In 2018, two long years after Pritchett’s discovery, the federal district court ruled in favor of France. For Pritchett, the decision was devastating. Millions of dollars of investor funding and years of labor were lost.
paragraphs.translationZh: I) 然后法律风暴开始了，GME 和 Pritchett 与佛罗里达和法国展开竞争。 2004 年的《沉没军事船只法》是一项美国联邦法案，保护任何执行军事任务的船只，允许原籍国甚至在几个世纪后也能认领其船只。 2018 年，即普里切特发现这一事件两年后，联邦地方法院做出了有利于法国的裁决。对于普里切特来说，这个决定是毁灭性的。数百万美元的投资者资金和多年的劳动力损失殆尽。

paragraphs.sourceText: J) But this is far from the first time a salvor has lost all rights to a discovery. In 2012, for instance, Spain won a five-year legal battle against Odyssey Marine Exploration, which had hauled 594,000 gold and silver coins from a Spanish wreck off the coast of Portugal across the Atlantic to the United States. “Treasure hunters can be naive,” says attorney David Concannon, who has had several maritime archaeologists as clients and represented two sides in the battles over the Titanic for 20 years. “Many treasure hunters don’t understand they are going to have to fight for their rights against a government that has an endless supply of money for legal battles that treasure hunters are likely to lose.”
paragraphs.translationZh: J) 但这并不是救助者第一次失去对发现的所有权利。例如，2012 年，西班牙赢得了与奥德赛海洋勘探公司 (Odyssey Marine Exploration) 长达五年的官司，该公司从葡萄牙海岸附近的一艘西班牙沉船中打捞出 594,000 枚金币和银币，穿过大西洋到达美国。 “寻宝者可能很天真，”律师戴维·康坎农 (David Concannon) 说，他的客户有几位海洋考古学家，并在泰坦尼克号争夺战中代表双方进行了 20 年。 “许多寻宝者不明白，他们将不得不与政府抗争，以争取自己的权利，因为政府拥有无穷无尽的资金来进行法律诉讼，而寻宝者很可能会失败。”

paragraphs.sourceText: K) Putting an inflated price on artifacts rather than viewing them as cultural and historical treasures that transcend any price is what irritates many archaeologists. For the archaeologist, everything in a wreck matters — hair, fabric, a fragment of a newspaper, rat bones — all things speak volumes. Archaeologists don’t want artifacts ending up in a private collection instead of taking humanity on a journey of understanding.
paragraphs.translationZh: K) 对文物定价过高，而不是将其视为超越任何价格的文化和历史珍宝，这激怒了许多考古学家。对于考古学家来说，沉船中的一切都很重要——头发、织物、报纸碎片、老鼠骨头——所有的东西都很重要。考古学家不希望文物最终被私人收藏，而不是带领人类踏上理解之旅。

paragraphs.sourceText: L) George Bass is one of the pioneers of under-water archaeology, and a researcher at Texas A&M University. He has testified in court against treasure hunters, but says archaeology is not without its own serious problems. He believes archaeologists need to do a better job themselves instead of routinely criticizing treasure hunters. “Archaeology has a terrible reputation for not publishing enough on its excavations (发掘) and finds,” he says. Gathering data, unearthing and meticulously preserving and examining finds, verifying identity and origin, piecing together the larger story, and writing and publishing a comprehensive paper or book can take decades. A bit cynically, Bass describes colleagues who never published because they waited so long they became ill or died. Who is more at fault, Bass asks, the professional archaeologist who carefully excavates a site and never publishes on it or the treasure hunter who locates a submerged wreck, salvages part, conserves part, and publishes a book on the operation?
paragraphs.translationZh: L) 乔治·巴斯（George Bass）是水下考古学的先驱之一，也是德克萨斯农工大学的研究员。他曾在法庭上作证反对寻宝者，但他表示考古学本身也存在严重问题。他认为考古学家自己需要做得更好，而不是例行公事地批评寻宝者。 “考古学因其挖掘和发现的报道不够多而享有盛誉，”他说。收集数据、挖掘、精心保存和检查发现物、验证身份和来源、拼凑出更大的故事，以及撰写和出版一篇综合论文或书籍，可能需要数十年的时间。巴斯有点愤世嫉俗地描述了那些从未发表文章的同事，因为他们等待得太久，以致生病或死亡。巴斯问道，谁的过错更大，是仔细挖掘遗址但从未发表过文章的专业考古学家，还是找到水下沉船、打捞部分、保存部分并出版一本有关这次行动的书的寻宝者？

paragraphs.sourceText: M) Pritchett concedes that his find deserves careful excavation and preservation. “I think what I found should go in a museum,” he says. “But I also think I should get paid for what I found.” Indeed, it’s a bit of a mystery why governments, archaeologists, and treasure hunters can’t work together — and why salvors aren’t at least given a substantial finder’s fee before the original owner takes possession of the vessel and its artifacts.
paragraphs.translationZh: M) Pritchett 承认他的发现值得仔细挖掘和保存。 “我认为我发现的东西应该进博物馆，”他说。 “但我也认为我应该为我的发现获得报酬。”事实上，为什么政府、考古学家和寻宝者不能合作，以及为什么在原主人拥有船只及其文物之前，打捞者至少得不到一笔可观的发现者费，这有点神秘。

paragraphs.sourceText: Could you get by without using the internet for four and a half years? That’s exactly what singer and actress Selena Gomez has done in a bid to improve her mental health.
paragraphs.translationZh: 你能四年半不使用互联网吗？这正是歌手兼演员赛琳娜·戈麦斯为改善心理健康所做的努力。

paragraphs.sourceText: She has spoken extensively about the relationship between her social media usage and her mental wellbeing, recalling feeling like “an addict” when she became Instagram’s most followed user in 2016. “Taking a break from social media was the best decision that I’ve ever made for my mental health,” says she. “The unnecessary hate and comparisons went away once I put my phone down.”
paragraphs.translationZh: 她广泛谈论了社交媒体的使用与心理健康之间的关系，回忆起 2016 年她成为 Instagram 上最受关注的用户时的感觉，就像“瘾君子”一样。“远离社交媒体是我为心理健康做出的最佳决定，”她说。 “一旦我放下手机，不必要的仇恨和比较就消失了。”

paragraphs.sourceText: Ditching the web at large, however, is a far more subtle and complicated prospect. The increasing digitisation of our society means that everything from paying a gas bill to plotting a route to a friend’s house and even making a phone call is at the mercy of your internet connection. Actively opting out of using the internet becomes a matter of privilege.
paragraphs.translationZh: 然而，彻底放弃网络是一个更加微妙和复杂的前景。我们社会的数字化程度不断提高，这意味着从支付煤气费到规划去朋友家的路线，甚至打电话，一切都取决于您的互联网连接。主动选择不使用互联网成为一种特权问题。

paragraphs.sourceText: Ms Gomez’s multi-millionaire status has allowed her to take the “social” out of social media, so she can continue to leverage her enormous fame while keeping the trolls (恶意挑衅的贴子) at bay . The fact that she’s still the second most-followed woman on Instagram suggests it’s entirely possible to maintain a significant web profile to promote various projects — by way of a dedicated team — without being exposed to the cruel comments, hate mail and rape or death threats.
paragraphs.translationZh: 戈麦斯女士的百万富翁身份使她能够将社交媒体中的“社交”功能去掉，这样她就可以继续利用自己巨大的名气，同时阻止恶意挑衅的贴子。事实上，她仍然是 Instagram 上关注度第二高的女性，这表明完全有可能通过专门的团队维持重要的网络形象来推广各种项目，而不会受到残酷评论、仇恨邮件以及强奸或死亡威胁。

paragraphs.sourceText: It goes without saying that this is fundamentally different from how the rest of us without beauty deals and films to publicise use the likes of Instagram, TikTok and Twitter, but even the concept of a digital detox (戒瘾) requires having a device and connectivity to choose to disconnect from.
paragraphs.translationZh: 不言而喻，这与我们其他人在没有美容交易和电影宣传的情况下使用 Instagram、TikTok 和 Twitter 之类的方式有着根本的不同，但即使是数字戒瘾的概念也需要有一个设备和连接来选择断开连接。

paragraphs.sourceText: The UK’s digital divide has worsened over the past two years, leaving poorer families without broadband connections in their homes. Digital exclusion is a major threat to wider societal equality in the UK, so witnessing companies like Facebook championing the metaverse (元宇宙) as the next great frontier when school children are struggling to complete their homework feels particularly irritating.
paragraphs.translationZh: 过去两年，英国的数字鸿沟进一步恶化，导致较贫困的家庭无法在家中使用宽带连接。数字排斥是对英国更广泛的社会平等的主要威胁，因此，当学生们努力完成作业时，看到 Facebook 等公司拥护元宇宙作为下一个伟大前沿，感觉特别令人恼火。

paragraphs.sourceText: Consequently, it’s worth bearing in mind that while deleting all social media accounts will undoubtedly make some feel infinitely better, many other people benefit from the strong sense of community that sharing platforms can breed.
paragraphs.translationZh: 因此，值得记住的是，虽然删除所有社交媒体帐户无疑会让一些人感觉无限好，但许多其他人受益于共享平台可以孕育的强烈社区意识。

paragraphs.sourceText: Internet access will continue to grow in importance as we edge further towards web 3.0, and greater resources and initiatives are needed to provide the underprivileged with the connectivity they desperately need to learn, work and live. It’s crucial that people who feel that social media is having a detrimental effect on their mental health are allowed to switch off — and for those living in digital exclusion to be able to switch on in the first place.
paragraphs.translationZh: 随着我们进一步迈向 Web 3.0，互联网接入的重要性将继续增强，需要更多的资源和举措来为弱势群体提供他们迫切需要的学习、工作和生活的连接。至关重要的是，那些认为社交媒体对其心理健康产生不利影响的人应该被允许关闭社交媒体，而对于那些生活在数字排斥中的人来说，首先要能够打开社交媒体。

paragraphs.sourceText: Questions 51 to 55 are based on the following passage.
paragraphs.translationZh: 问题 51 至 55 基于以下段落。

paragraphs.sourceText: Psychologists have long been in disagreement as to whether competition is a learned or a genetic component of human behavior. Whatever it is, you cannot but recognize the effect competition is exerting in academics and many other areas of contemporary life.
paragraphs.translationZh: 对于竞争是人类行为的后天习得还是遗传因素，心理学家长期以来一直存在分歧。不管是什么，你都不能不认识到竞争在学术和当代生活的许多其他领域所产生的影响。

paragraphs.sourceText: Psychologically speaking, competition has been seen as an inevitable consequence of human drives. According to Sigmund Freud, humans are born screaming for attention and full of organic drives for fulfillment in various areas. Initially, we compete for the attention of our parents. Thereafter, we are at the mercy of a battle between our base impulses for self-fulfillment and social and cultural norms which prohibit pure indulgence.
paragraphs.translationZh: 从心理学上来说，竞争被视为人类驱动力的必然结果。根据西格蒙德·弗洛伊德的说法，人类生来就渴望得到关注，并且在各个领域都充满了追求成就感的有机驱动力。最初，我们争夺父母的注意力。此后，我们就会受到自我实现的基本冲动与禁止纯粹放纵的社会和文化规范之间的斗争的摆布。

paragraphs.sourceText: Current work in anthropology (人类学) has suggested, however, that this view of the role of competition in human behavior may be incorrect. Thomas Hobbes, one of the great philosophers of the seventeenth century, is perhaps best remembered for his characterization of the “natural world”, that is, the world before the imposition of the will of humanity, as being “nasty, brutish, and short.” This image of the pre-rational world is still widely held, reinforced by Charles Darwin’s highly influential work. The Origin of Species. which established the doctrine of natural selection. This doctrine, which takes for granted that those species best able to adapt to and master the natural environment in which they live will survive, has suggested that the struggle for survival is an inherent human trait which determines a person’s success. Darwin’s theory has even been summarized as “survival of the fittest” — a phrase Darwin himself never used — further highlighting competition’s role in success. As it has often been pointed out, however, there is nothing in the concept of natural selection that suggests that competition is the most successful strategy for “survival of the fittest.” Darwin asserted in The Origin of Species that the struggles he was describing should be viewed as metaphors and could easily include dependence and cooperation.
paragraphs.translationZh: 然而，人类学当前的研究表明，这种关于竞争在人类行为中的作用的观点可能是不正确的。托马斯·霍布斯是十七世纪最伟大的哲学家之一，他最为人们所铭记的也许是他对“自然世界”的描述，即强加人类意志之前的世界，是“肮脏、野蛮和短暂的”。这种前理性世界的形象仍然被广泛持有，查尔斯·达尔文极具影响力的著作进一步强化了这一形象。物种起源。从而确立了自然选择学说。这一学说理所当然地认为，那些最能适应和掌握其所生活的自然环境的物种将会生存下来，它表明，为生存而奋斗是人类固有的特征，决定了一个人的成功。达尔文的理论甚至被概括为“适者生存”——达尔文本人从未使用过这个词——进一步强调了竞争在成功中的作用。然而，正如人们经常指出的那样，自然选择的概念中并没有表明竞争是“适者生存”的最成功的策略。达尔文在《物种起源》中断言，他所描述的斗争应该被视为隐喻，并且很容易包括依赖和合作。

paragraphs.sourceText: Many studies have been conducted to test the importance placed on competition as opposed to other values, such as cooperation — by various cultures, and generally conclude that Americans uniquely praise competition as natural, inevitable, and desirable. In 1937, the world-renowned anthropologist Margaret Mead published Cooperation and Competition among Primitive Peoples, based on her studies of several societies that did not prize competition, and, in fact, seemed at times to place a negative value on it. One such society was the Zuni Indians of Arizona, and they, Mead found, valued cooperation far more than competition. After studying dozens of such cultures, Mead’s final conclusion was that competitiveness is a culturally created aspect of human behavior, and that its prevalence in a particular society is relative to how that society values it.
paragraphs.translationZh: 已经进行了许多研究来检验不同文化对竞争相对于其他价值观（例如合作）的重视程度，并普遍得出结论，美国人独特地称赞竞争是自然的、不可避免的和可取的。 1937 年，世界著名人类学家玛格丽特·米德 (Margaret Mead) 出版了《原始民族之间的合作与竞争》一书，该书基于她对几个不重视竞争、事实上有时似乎对竞争给予负面评价的社会的研究。亚利桑那州的祖尼印第安人就是这样的一个社会，米德发现，他们重视合作远甚于竞争。在研究了数十种此类文化后，米德的最终结论是，竞争力是人类行为的文化创造的一个方面，它在特定社会中的流行程度与该社会如何评价它有关。
